candidates.change_summary: Replace assignment to betLimit with assignment to betLimit plus the provided amount (making betLimit accumulate rather than set).
Replace assignment to betLimit with assignment to amount + 1 (introduce an off-by-one change).
Relax onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller (remove the require), so AdjustBetAmounts can be called by non-owners and change betLimit when invoked by others.
Assigns difficulty from msg.sender (address cast) instead of using the provided amount, changing stored difficulty after AdjustDifficulty is called.
Sets difficulty to zero regardless of the provided amount, so AdjustDifficulty always clears difficulty.
Negates the provided amount (as uint256 complement) before storing, changing difficulty to bitwise NOT of amount.
Adds 1 to the provided amount before storing, so difficulty becomes amount+1.
Changes onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller by removing the require, so AdjustDifficulty can be called by non-owner and set difficulty accordingly (behaviorally observable).
